parse.title: Sorcerer Killer
parse.text:
Limited Unit
This unit is only available for a short time!

Overview

Sorcerer Killer is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing the Restriction Portal portal (guaranteed if you are the host). The Secret Portal Drop Rate is believed to be 1%.

Evolving

Sorcerer Killer can evolve into Sorcerer Killer (Heavenly Body) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Sorcerer Killer
x200 Sacred Treasure
x12 Star Fruit
x5 Star Fruit (Red)
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Sorcerer Killer (Heavenly Body)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
